description: Connect your AVSBL account to create and edit saved website drafts through ChatGPT. Describe your business and ask for pages, sections, text, colours, buttons, or image placement. ChatGPT uses AVSBL’s existing builder options, and you can continue editing in AVSBL. The plugin can read your draft and approved project images, import images you choose to attach, and save supported draft changes. It cannot publish a website; you review and publish manually in AVSBL. An AVSBL account with website access is required.

defaultPrompt: Create a website draft for my business using these details and photos.
Change the colours and text on my AVSBL website draft.
Show me my Contact page and update its button.
